digest.component_or_area: DC codec live harness + inbound reconciler
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields to verify Jira interprets wiki markup (heading/bold/code-macro) correctly, not just validate wiki source
State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass to confirm a converged rich body decodes to unchanged value and triggers no re-push, holding against real DC renderer

Both-sides concurrent edit (rebar-side and Jira-side description changes before next pass) must keep local body (local-wins) and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert while recording remote value
Inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression by treating Jira's echoed value as unchanged when it matches the local body's landed wire form (mirror of outbound _baseline_form_matches)
normalize_rich_text public signature and behavior must be pinned via cross-repo contract test so breaking changes to InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text fail in this package first
DC rich-text cutover (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc) must be enabled in live test to exercise Markdown-to-wiki codec conversion and prove convergence under real renderer
